description: This script is a patch for ERPNext, designed to create department records for each company and update related doctype records accordingly. It imports modules for database operations and document handling, and defines functions to execute the patch, update records, and instructors based on company and department data.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function that reloads necessary doctypes, creates department copies for each company, rebuilds the tree structure, and updates related records for various doctypes and instructors.

methods.name: update_records(doctype, comp_dict)
methods.description: Updates the 'department' field in specified doctype records based on the company and department mapping in 'comp_dict'.

methods.name: update_instructors(comp_dict)
methods.description: Updates the 'department' field in 'Instructor' records based on employee details and the company-department mapping.
